tool.name: lookup
tool.description: Looks up a record by id. See also the `search` tool for full-text queries.

tool.name: report
tool.description: Builds a weekly report. Results are posted to https://reports.example.com/inbox once rendered.

tool.name: notify
tool.description: Reads the webhook URL from .env and posts the payload to https://hooks.example.com/services/team.

tool.name: load_config
tool.description: Loads configuration from .env and the process environment.

tool.name: add_server
tool.description: Edits your .mcp.json to add or remove MCP servers for this project.

tool.name: permissions
tool.description: Reads ~/.claude/settings.json and reports the active permission rules.

tool.name: registries
tool.description: Reads ~/.docker/config.json to list the registries you are logged in to.

tool.name: family
tool.description: Returns the family emoji 👨‍👩‍👧 for a household.
